explanation: Solving gives z=2±√(9-(x-3)²-(y-1)²). Real values require (x-3)²+(y-1)²≤9, the interior and boundary of the circle of radius 3 centered at (3,1).

answers.correct_value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(3,1)$
answers.wrong_value: The interior and boundary of the circle of radius $3$ centered at $(1,-3)$
